concept: A high-energy, fast-paced 'Sports Multitasking' POV that bridges the gap between the intense Olympic Hockey schedule/overtime rules and the current NHL star power of Marner and Suzuki, utilizing a Kristen Bell-inspired 'relatable breakdown' aesthetic.
steps: Open with a 0.5x zoom selfie video of you looking frantically between three different screens (phone, laptop, TV).
Flash a screenshot of the Olympic Hockey Schedule with a 'Confused' filter when mentioning the overtime rules.
Rapid-fire cut between highlights (or trading cards) of Mitch Marner, Nick Suzuki, and Jordan Binnington to a heavy bass beat.
Transition to a green screen showing the Levante vs Villarreal scoreline to emphasize the 'Global Sports Overload' feeling.
End with a direct-to-camera 'Kristen Bell style' whisper-rant about which team actually wins in 3-on-3 overtime.
hooks: The Olympic Hockey rule that is about to ruin your sleep schedule.
Why Mitch Marner and Nick Suzuki are the only duo that matters right now.

coach_summary: This execution works because it combines high-intent search terms (Olympic rules/schedule) with established fanbases (Marner/Suzuki). The 'chaos' aesthetic drives high retention, while the question about Gold medals forces engagement in the comments.
